name: VRM_CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HDRS_GT
description: Oracle internal use only. This global temporary table is used in identify customer contracts job during internal processing.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE_CLOSED
columns.description: Date on which the contract is fully satisfied and fully billed.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Customer contract number. This is a running sequence number.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_DATE
columns.description: Customer contract date. Used for deriving price effectivity period of the customer contract.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the contract will be frozen for automatic inclusion of new lines by the Identify Customer Contracts program. The value will be defaulted by adding the freeze period defined in the contract identification rule to the contract date.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Classification code of a contract. Values are derived from lookup type ORA_VRM_CONTRACT_CLASSIF_CODE.

columns.name: CONTRACT_RULE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the customer contract identification rule.

columns.name: EFFECTIVITY_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a standard sales price effectivity period. Derived using the customer contract date.

columns.name: REVIEW_STATUS
columns.description: Review status of the customer contract. Values are derived from lookup type ORA_VRM_CONTRACT_REVIEW_STATUS.

columns.name: REVIEW_REQUIRED_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for which contract is pending for review. Values are from the lookup ORA_REVIEW_REQUIRED_REASON. Possible values are ORA_SOURCE_HOLD, ORA_TRANS_PRICE_THRESHOLD, ORA_MANUAL_HOLD.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_STATUS
columns.description: Allocation status of the customer contract. Values are derived from lookup type ORA_VRM_CONTRACT_ALLOCN_STATUS.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_PENDING_REASON
columns.description: If the allocation of the contract is pending, then this attribute captures the reason it is pending. Values are derived from lookup type ORA_ALLOCATION_PENDING_REASON.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Contract currency code. Populated with ledger currency code.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TRANSACTION_PRICE
columns.description: Total contract amount (transaction price) in the contract currency.  It is the sum of the net consideration amount of all obligations.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_NONEXEMPT_TRX_PRICE
columns.description: Total nonexempt transaction price in the contract currency. The value is derived from the transaction price after excluding the exempt perfomance obligation amounts.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TOTAL_RECOG_REV_AMT
columns.description: Total revenue recognized of all the performance obligations in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TOTAL_BILLED_AMT
columns.description: Total billed amount of all the performance obligations in the contract currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for converting amounts from contract currency to ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type of the contract.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Conversion date to be used for conversion.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifer of the customer contract.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity of the customer contract.

columns.name: SINGLE_OBLIGATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether contract has single or multiple obligations. Y means single obligation contract and N means multiple obligation contract.

columns.name: STANDALONE_SALES_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether the contract is included for observed standalone selling price calculation.

columns.name: IS_EXCH_RATE_INFO_AVAILABLE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created..

columns.name: CONTRACT_HASH_CODE
columns.description: Contract processing unique identifier.

columns.name: REFERENCE
columns.description: User entered contract reference or grouping attribute values used to identify the contract as derived by enabling the Copy to Reference option in the Contract Identification rule.

columns.name: CONTRACT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: LATEST_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Latest immaterial change type processed on this customer contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_TYPE.

columns.name: CONTRACT_MODIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the revenue contract was modified.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_MOD_DATE_ALLOC_AMT
columns.description: Allocated amount as of the contract modification date in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_MOD_DATE_CARVE_AMT
columns.description: Discounted amount in the contract currency as of the contract revision date.

columns.name: CONTRACT_GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Concatenation of the original customer contract's source document number and customer contract number for the recurring line.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Contract's eligibility for adjustment by the Residual Account Balance Write Off process. Values are from the lookup type ORA_ADJUSTMENT_STATUS.

columns.name: EXCL_FROM_AUTO_WRITEOFF_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the contract will be excluded from processing by the Residual Account Balance Write Off process. Values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the last activity was performed on the contract.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Overall satisfaction status of the contract. When all of the performance obligations in the contract are fully satisfied, the status is set to Fully Satisfied and the Satisfaction Date is set to Max (Satisfaction Date) of all the performance obligations of the contract. When at least performance obligation in the contract is not fully satisfied, then the status is set to Not Satisfied. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATISFACTION_STATUS.

columns.name: FULL_SATISFACTION_DATE
columns.description: Latest satisfaction date for all of the performance obligations within a contract when all performance obligations in the contract are fully satisified. Use in conjunction with the SATISFACTION_STATUS column.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: The allocation currency basis used to allocate and recognize revenue for a contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOCATION_METHOD.

columns.name: ENTER_CURR_MOD_DATE_ALLOC_AMT
columns.description: Allocated amount as of the contract modification date in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTER_CURR_MOD_DATE_CARVE_AMT
columns.description: Discounted amount in the entered currency as of the contract revision date.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The transaction currency code used for revenue contract.

columns.name: ENTER_CURR_TRANSACTION_PRICE
columns.description: Total contract amount (transaction price) in the entered currency, which is the sum of the net consideration amount of all obligations.

columns.name: ENTER_CURR_TOTAL_RECOG_REV_AMT
columns.description: Total revenue recognized for all the performance obligations in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTER_CURR_TOTAL_BILLED_AMT
columns.description: Total billed amount for all the performance obligations in the entered currency.

columns.name: CURR_REVAL_OFFSET_ADJ_STATUS
columns.description: Contract's eligibility for adjustment by the Residual Account Balance Write Off process. Values are from the lookup type ORA_CURR_REVAL_OFFSET_ADJ_STATUS.
